title: A picnic, decided by the weather dice
checked: Every reachable state checked (11 states, 17 with their data, 57 steps). All 5 rules hold.

rules.rule: Every step can happen, and none is a dead end
rules.says: Each of the 11 states is reached from the start, every step can fire, and no state leaves you stuck.

rules.rule: The picnic is on the rug
rules.says: The basket opens only on square 9. No roll lets you eat on the way.
rules.path: Take away the at the rug guard and it breaks in 1 step: roll a 1.

rules.says: In the rain, everyone waits in the bandstand. No picnic starts wet.
rules.path: Take away the at the rug guard and it breaks in 1 step: roll a 6.

rules.says: You go to the bandstand only when the die shows rain.
rules.path: Take away the raining guard and it breaks in 1 step: roll a 1.

rules.says: A roll that would carry you past square 9 leaves you where you are.
